registry_info.name: chaos
registry_info.description: Chaos theory artifacts — Lyapunov exponents, strange attractors, and the sensitive dependence on initial conditions that makes deterministic systems unpredictable.
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Dynamical systems theory, Lyapunov stability, strange attractors (Lorenz, Rössler), fractal dimension, ergodic theory

lyapunov_exponents.name: Lyapunov Exponents
lyapunov_exponents.description: Visualization of Lyapunov exponents — the rate at which nearby trajectories diverge in phase space. Positive exponents mean chaos: small differences amplify exponentially, making long-term prediction impossible.
lyapunov_exponents.qfep_connection: Lyapunov exponents measure φΔE(S,t) — the rate at which nearby trajectories diverge. Positive exponent = high sensitivity, the system amplifies small differences. This IS the sensitivity term: how fast entropy changes.

strange_attractors.name: Strange Attractors
strange_attractors.description: Gallery of strange attractors — Lorenz, Rössler, and others. Deterministic systems that never repeat yet stay bounded, tracing fractal paths through phase space forever.
strange_attractors.qfep_connection: Systems that never repeat but never escape — bounded chaos. The attractor IS the edge of chaos geometry: infinite complexity E(S) confined to finite structure F. Same equations, different initial conditions yield different trajectories but the same attractor shape.

lyapunov_fractal.name: Lyapunov Fractal
lyapunov_fractal.description: Lyapunov fractal from alternating logistic map parameters — for each point (a,b) in parameter space [2,4]x[2,4], iterate x=r*x*(1-x) alternating r between a and b in pattern AABB. The Lyapunov exponent λ colors the plane: blue for stable orbits (λ<0), yellow-red for chaos (λ>0), black at the boundary. The result resembles alien calligraphy.
lyapunov_fractal.qfep_connection: Maps regions of parameter space by stability — blue = ordered (λ→0), warm = chaotic (λ→1). The fractal boundary between them IS the edge of chaos rendered as image. The alien calligraphy traces exactly where F-minimization fails.
